checks.claim: Q_sp>0 and finite, and the temporal form is strictly positive for signed tau via the Volterra/lambda identity, giving infinitude.
checks.reason: For y in B_L and x in B_(L+1), both q factors are at least 1 on B_(2L+1), so Q_sp>=|B_(L+1)|Gamma(B_L)>0. I rechecked the factorization int_(-inf)^min 2 lambda e^(-lambda(t-u)) e^(-lambda(s-u)) du = e^(-lambda|t-s|). Tonelli applies through the Schur bound. E_lambda=0 for some lambda gives v=0 by continuity, and v'=lambda v-tau gives tau=0. The map tau to tau tensor q is therefore injective on an infinite-dimensional space.
